unreachable: We can't reach the server right now. The import continues anyway; the page tries again.
busy: Claude is very busy right now. Simon Says waits {seconds} s and tries again.
stopped: The import was stopped. Try again later.
cancelFailed: The import couldn't be cancelled right now. Try again.
offline: We couldn't reach the server. Try again.
digestingHeadline: {done} of {total} read{failed} · goals proposed within about 10 min
digestingDetail: Claude has finished reading. The goals are proposed at the next run (within 5 minutes) and then take a few minutes: Simon Says reads the whole history in order. You can close the page — the proposal waits here when you come back.
cancelingDetail: Claude is stopping the batch. What has already been read is kept (it's paid for), but no goals are proposed. It usually takes a minute or so.
etaSoon: time left is worked out in a moment
etaFirst: time left is worked out when the first set of minutes is done
batchStarted: Claude has received all the minutes at once (at half price) and has started. Most batches are done within an hour, all within a day.
batchReading: Claude reads all the minutes at once (at half price). The results come when the whole batch is done.
batchClose: You can close the page — we carry on and show the result here when you come back.
pausedDetail: The import paused when the page was closed. Continue where it stopped.
directDetail: Simon Says reads {count} sets of minutes at a time. Keep the page open until it's done; if you close it the import pauses and you can continue here later.
partImported: {count, plural, one {# set of minutes imported} other {# sets of minutes imported}}
failedDetail: Simon Says couldn't send the minutes to Claude. Nothing has cost anything. Close and try again in a little while.
tooFew: Simon Says needs at least 3 meetings or sets of minutes to propose goals.
proposalFailed: Simon Says couldn't propose goals this time. You can ask for a proposal again.
trimmed: The history was too long to read in one go: the proposal rests on the latest {meetings} meetings ({trimmed} older ones were left out).
cancelBatch: Cancel? What has already been read is kept.
cancelDirect: Cancel? The minutes that are done are kept.
dateFromFile: Date from the file — check it afterwards.
